preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The length of s is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() or c == ' ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: s contains only English letters, digits, and spaces.

preconditions.expression: len([w for w in s.split() if w]) >= 1
preconditions.description: There is at least one word in s.

postconditions.description: The returned string is the sequence of words from s in reverse order, separated by a single space, with no leading or trailing spaces.
